readiness.headline: Migration readiness: Needs attention
readiness.narrative: Duplicate item codes are the primary blocker because they affect how products will be uniquely identified. Most duplicate groups occur across subsidiaries, suggesting that SKU may only be unique within a subsidiary. Most invalid UOM values are recognizable aliases and can likely be normalized automatically. Category provides evidence for inferring some missing Product Type values, while ambiguous records still require review.

evidence.label: invalid UOM rows match recognized aliases
missing Product Type rows have Category evidence

fields.name: SKU
fields.roleTip: A field the system infers may uniquely identify each record. Not a confirmed identifier until you approve it.
fields.impactReason: 918 duplicate values would collide on the migration import key, so SKU cannot be used as-is as the record identifier.
fields.interpretation: SKU is a strong identifier candidate, but it is not globally unique. Evaluate SKU + Subsidiary as a composite identifier before confirming.
fields.reasoning: The only field that is both near-unique and consistently formatted; aligns with Odoo default_code. Ranked as the primary identifier candidate.

fields.name: Product Name
fields.roleTip: Human-readable label for the record.
fields.impactReason: Fully populated, well-formed descriptive text. No migration issues detected.
fields.reasoning: High cardinality free text used as the product display name. Maps directly to Odoo name.

fields.name: Product Type
fields.roleTip: A field with a small set of repeating values that map to a target list.
fields.impactReason: 126 rows are blank. Category provides high-confidence evidence for 96 of them; the rest are ambiguous and need review before import.
fields.interpretation: Category provides high-confidence evidence for 96 of 126 blank rows. The remaining 30 rows are ambiguous or lack Category evidence and need review — no values are inferred until you approve them on Value Mapping.
fields.reasoning: Maps to Odoo product type (storable / consumable / service). Blanks are inferred from Category where evidence is strong.

fields.name: UOM
fields.roleTip: A field with a small set of repeating values that map to a target reference list.
fields.impactReason: 6 source values have no matching Odoo unit (304 rows). Reference integrity fails until these are crosswalked — a blocker for unit-priced products.
fields.interpretation: Most invalid UOM values are recognized aliases that can be normalized on Value Mapping; 17 rows (BX10) have no known equivalent and need review. Nothing is normalized on this page.
fields.reasoning: Unit-of-measure reference. "PCS", "PC" and "Pieces" all alias to EA; "BX10" is unresolved.

fields.name: Unit Price
fields.roleTip: A numeric quantity.
fields.impactReason: 18 values sit far outside the interquartile range — likely unit or currency-entry errors. Migration-safe but worth reviewing.
fields.interpretation: 18 values sit far outside the interquartile range — likely unit or currency errors. Review the affected records before import; no values are changed here.
fields.reasoning: Continuous currency measure. Outliers flagged with the IQR method (1.5× interquartile range).

fields.name: Created Date
fields.roleTip: A date or timestamp field.
fields.impactReason: Stored as 8-digit integers (YYYYMMDD). A deterministic transform to ISO 8601 is required before import; 12 rows are future-dated.
fields.interpretation: Stored as 8-digit integers (YYYYMMDD) and 100% format-consistent, so a deterministic transform to ISO 8601 is straightforward; 12 rows are future-dated and should be reviewed.
fields.reasoning: Integer values in YYYYMMDD form. Needs a transform on Field Mapping before import.

fields.name: Subsidiary
fields.roleTip: A small set of repeating values that map to a target reference list.
fields.impactReason: Clean reference field. Its main role is as the second half of a proposed SKU + Subsidiary composite identifier.
fields.interpretation: A clean reference / enumeration field. Combined with SKU it yields 99.98% composite uniqueness — the strongest composite identifier candidate for this dataset.
fields.reasoning: Six legal entities. Passes reference integrity. Key input to the composite-identifier evaluation.

fields.name: Category
fields.roleTip: A repeating grouping value that maps to a target category tree.
fields.impactReason: 12% of rows have no Category. Overlaps 71% with Product Type and is a candidate for enumeration / reference mapping.
fields.interpretation: Free-text category with 64 distinct values that overlaps 71% with Product Type — likely a finer grouping. A candidate for enumeration / reference mapping.
fields.reasoning: Low cardinality, high repetition — a reference/grouping field. Maps to an Odoo product category.

fields.name: Barcode
fields.roleTip: A field the system infers may uniquely identify each record. Not confirmed until you approve it.
fields.impactReason: A secondary identifier candidate, but 24% empty and moderately noisy — weaker than SKU. Usable as an alternate key at best.
fields.interpretation: A secondary identifier candidate, but 24% empty and moderately noisy — weaker than SKU. Consider it only as an alternate key.
fields.reasoning: 82% of values match EAN-13; 118 are "N/A" and 59 duplicate. Lower confidence than SKU.

fields.name: Cost
fields.roleTip: A numeric quantity.
fields.impactReason: Well-formed numeric measure with 8% blanks — within acceptable tolerance. No blocking issues.
fields.reasoning: Continuous currency measure. No outliers detected.

fields.name: Vendor
fields.roleTip: A repeating reference value.
fields.impactReason: Supplier reference with 5% blanks. Maps cleanly to an Odoo vendor reference.
fields.reasoning: Company reference field, 380 distinct suppliers. Maps to res.partner.

fields.name: Weight (kg)
fields.roleTip: A numeric quantity.
fields.impactReason: Numeric measure with 6% blanks. No anomalies detected.
fields.reasoning: Continuous numeric measure in kilograms.

fields.name: Legacy Drawing Code
fields.roleTip: A free-text field with no strong inferred role.
fields.impactReason: Near-empty: only 1.74% populated and not required by the target system. Recommended for review before exclusion — not auto-excluded.
fields.interpretation: Almost entirely empty (1.74% populated) and not required by Odoo. Recommended for review before exclusion — near-empty fields are never excluded automatically.
fields.reasoning: 97.7% empty legacy reference. Unlikely to carry migration value.

fields.name: Description
fields.roleTip: A free-text field with no strong inferred role.
fields.impactReason: Free-text description with 4% blanks. Maps to Odoo description.
fields.reasoning: High-cardinality descriptive text.

copilotPrompts.text: Why do you think SKU is the identifier?
Ignore columns that are more than 95% empty
Which problems can be fixed automatically?

idprob.text: Filtered the workspace to identifier-candidate fields with unresolved issues. SKU has 918 duplicate values — the top migration blocker — and Barcode is 24% empty. This is a temporary visual filter; nothing in your migration config changes until you approve a fix.

whysku.text: SKU is 100% populated, 97.8% unique, and matches the naming pattern of a stock-keeping identifier. It is the strongest identifier candidate — but it is not globally unique, so I opened its field profile so you can inspect the duplicate groups and the SKU + Subsidiary composite before confirming.

ignore.text: One field is more than 95% empty: Legacy Drawing Code (1.74% populated). Ignoring a field changes the migration configuration, so I have opened an approval dialog rather than applying it directly.

compare.text: Opened a side-by-side comparison of Category and Product Type. They share 71% of values — Product Type looks like a coarser grouping of Category. 126 rows have a Category but no Product Type.

autofix.text: Four issues have proposed fixes. Two can be applied automatically by the deterministic engine; two need your review. Applying any of them updates the migration configuration and always asks for your approval first.

date.evidence: Source format YYYYMMDD detected on 100% of values

type.evidence: Category present for 112 of 126 blank rows

proposals.name: Base Price
proposals.why: Numeric selling prices best match the Odoo Sales Price (list_price). Confidence is just below the auto-accept band because the column could also represent cost — confirm this is a sell price. Currency/decimal formatting is resolved on Page 4.

proposals.name: Expense Account
proposals.why: Expense Account contains general-ledger account references. Expense Account (property_account_expense_id) is the closest compatible Odoo target based on its business meaning, sample values and previously approved mappings. The GL account labels don’t match Odoo account records yet, so a reference-value crosswalk is required on Page 4.

proposals.name: Item Type
proposals.why: The Goods / Service enumeration determines whether a record is a stockable product or a service in Odoo, governed by Product Type. The source values are enumerations, so the Goods→consu / Service→service value crosswalk happens on Page 4.

proposals.name: UOM
proposals.why: Maps to Unit of Measure. Some source codes (EA, BOX) have no direct Odoo unit and will need a value crosswalk on Page 4.

proposals.name: Subsidiary
samples: Tartan Aerial Sense Tech Pvt Ltd
proposals.why: The source names legal entities and maps to the Odoo Company field, but the labels do not exactly match existing company records — reference-record value mapping will be required on Page 4.

proposals.name: Created Date
proposals.why: The integer YYYYMMDD parses to a creation timestamp, but create_date in Odoo is system-managed and not writable on import. The target is unavailable — route this to a custom writable field or drop it before continuing.

proposals.name: Tax Code
proposals.why: Tax codes resemble Customer Taxes references, but confidence is low and the codes must be crosswalked to Odoo tax records on Page 4.

proposals.name: Legacy Code
proposals.why: A legacy identifier with no strong target. It could map to Internal Reference (default_code) at low confidence, or be excluded if it is not needed in Odoo.

proposals.name: Unknown Flag
proposals.why: No confident target. The boolean has no clear business meaning from the header alone — assign a target, add a default, or exclude it.

proposals.name: Internal Notes
proposals.why: Excluded on this file by a user rule — internal free-text notes are not migrated to Odoo.

proposals.name: List Price INR
proposals.why: Currency-denominated selling price; maps to Sales Price but needs currency/decimal normalization on Page 4.

proposals.name: Standard Cost
proposals.why: Numeric unit cost aligns with the Odoo Cost field.

proposals.name: Product Family
proposals.why: Groups products into families that map to Odoo Product Category; family names need a value crosswalk on Page 4.

proposals.name: Brand
proposals.why: Brand can seed a product category but overlaps with Product Family — confirm the intended category source.

proposals.name: Long Description
proposals.why: Free-text description close to Purchase Description; confirm sales vs. purchase description target.

proposals.name: Net Weight
proposals.why: Numeric mass maps directly to the Odoo Weight field.

proposals.name: Gross Weight
proposals.why: Also a mass value; conflicts with Net Weight for the single Weight target — pick one.

proposals.name: Sales UOM
proposals.why: Sales unit of measure; codes need crosswalk to Odoo units on Page 4.

proposals.name: Purchase UOM
proposals.why: Purchase unit of measure; overlaps with Sales UOM on the single UoM target.

proposals.name: Vendor Name
proposals.why: Vendor references need matching to existing records on Page 4.

proposals.name: Product Status
proposals.why: Low-confidence match to Product Type; likely a lifecycle flag needing its own target.

proposals.name: Is Active
proposals.why: Boolean active flag with no confident target — add a default or exclude.

proposals.name: Modified Date
proposals.why: write_date is system-managed and not writable on import — target unavailable.

proposals.name: EAN
proposals.why: EAN barcodes map directly to the Odoo Barcode field.

proposals.name: MPN
proposals.why: Manufacturer part number could serve as Internal Reference; conflicts with SKU on default_code.

proposals.name: Category Code
proposals.why: Coded category values need crosswalk to Odoo category records on Page 4.

proposals.name: Tax Class
proposals.why: Tax classes map to Customer Taxes after crosswalking to Odoo tax records.

proposals.name: Comments
proposals.why: Excluded by user rule — free-text comments are not migrated.

proposals.name: Warehouse
proposals.why: Warehouse codes loosely map to Company; confirm and crosswalk on Page 4.

proposals.name: Currency
proposals.why: Currency has no direct product-master target — handled by pricelists, not a field mapping.

missingTargets.name: —
missingTargets.why: Product Category (categ_id) is required by Odoo but no source field maps to it. Map a source field or set a project-wide default value on Page 4.

missingTargets.name: —
missingTargets.why: Invoicing Policy (invoice_policy) is required for storable products. No source field supplies it — a default population method is required.

readiness.headline: Mapping readiness: Needs attention
readiness.narrative: Most source fields map cleanly to Odoo product fields on name, datatype and previously approved mappings. The exceptions cluster in two places: GL account references, whose labels do not match Odoo account records and need a crosswalk, and two required Odoo targets that no source field supplies at all. Nothing is written until each proposal is accepted.
